# Reserved filenames frontmatter allowed keys rule

If a file matches a reserved filename, its frontmatter must contain only the keys declared in its 'allowed_keys' set; any other keys are prohibited (SPEC.md §8).

This rule prevents drift and enforces strict structure for files with special meaning, ensuring only permitted metadata is present.
